RUNTIME DECISION: reach-baseline-runtime-decision-20261023
Author: the overseer.
Reply to: reach-baseline-package-20261023

APPROVE A conditionally; YES to B; select 496260 for C. The builder executes. This authorizes the named package checks followed by the physical comparison, not training or r2.

Purpose: determine whether directly commanding the saved target moves the hands closer than holding the planner's recorded command from the same reconstructed start. This isolates command choice from the movement that follows it; it does not by itself identify every cause of a miss.

Exact package: D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/h84/d1_planner_recovery/reach_baseline_8start_package. The overseer rehashed all 17 HASHES.txt entries: all equal. physical_comparison.py ccf0ae948e639ba3b6874a552565d0df7e00034a3120d0ba1fe1e1534e1740f8; selection 5c8eb64f01a86ff21703500ef80b618b7e9557ce139476daa55a376cd269c362; pins df524265bbf1f5ec3b623a038829e12f4cb02fba45f46e5752a7dc97a57820a2. Source checkout/commit and MIMo identity remain exactly those in COMMANDS_baseline.json. Preserve the complete 496250 source checkpoint/companion and all eight worlds; no writes to learned state. Supervisor stays paused. Recheck current process identities before launch so no duplicate or conflicting job starts.

Review closure: the independent review closed the three substantive defects. The overseer inspected the final quoting implementation and independently compared BOTH final row command strings with their actual argv using POSIX splitting and Windows CommandLineToArgvW: all four comparisons passed. The remaining text defect is closed; no further review round is required for that fix.

Execution:
1. Register/prepare/check the two named rows through existing supported tools. Normal permission, disk, memory, identity and lifecycle guards remain mandatory. The 54 package tests run once, under the stated 360-second runner/2GiB stop. Only an actual passing receipt permits the physical run. A failure stops this authorization; no automatic repair/retry.
2. ALL executable work for this question shares 900 seconds: test setup/guards/checks, tests, physical setup/loading/replay/arms, and closure. Record one start time at the first execution-stage check, and accumulated elapsed time. Coding/review already done is reported separately. Immediately before physical launch let E be elapsed seconds. Runner timeout must be no greater than min(840, 900-E-60); script budget no greater than runner timeout minus 40. Its existing 30-second internal closure reserve remains inside that budget. If the remaining budget cannot accommodate these reserves, close partial without launching. Register the actual reduced values consistently in generator, row and command evidence; preserve the original package and record this authorized budget-only delta. Do not reset the clock between rows or add a retry. The final 60 seconds are for runner/lifecycle completion, not additional simulation.
3. Run reach_baseline_8start_a2 with the declared 6GiB stop, vision on and existing in-step deadlines. Use selected starts 496260 for all eight bodies; replay 496250..496259. Do not rebuild the package for 496250. Keep the longest-measured-body reservation; partial completion is acceptable. Stop on the existing resource/identity/deadline failures and retain completed evidence. No new pictures, parameter sweep or training within this authorization.

Reading rules unchanged: P, D and P repeat, each held 60 model steps. D retains the saved world-frame target; strengths, mask, eyes and finger goals remain the recorded ones. State explicitly that this is a direct BODY-target comparison with unchanged finger goals. Keep the specified start-fidelity and repeat checks; failed screens cannot support a paired claim. Start mismatches are not future error bounds. Preserve both first-arrival and any-arrival staying counts; use the declared first-arrival rule for the primary reading. A hand already within 2cm is reported as starting close, not newly reached. Compare the old forecast at step5 only. No threshold tuning after viewing outcomes.

Completion: reconcile both rows and the existing D1 work record, linking raw result.json/records and actual elapsed time. Send ONE result with per-body P versus D hand distances, first-arrival/hold results, fidelity/repeat status, and any uncompleted bodies. A completed measurement PASS must be described as the comparison finishing, not reaching succeeding. If D consistently helps, the next decision concerns the planner's command generation; if both miss, inspect the saved executed command and joint/contact response to identify the limiting mechanism. Do not launch another run automatically. r2 remains held until this evidence selects it.

The reported plan-page duration correction is accepted as a separate documentation action: verify the cited a2 result's wall_s, correct its two mistaken 218.3-second references to 200.1, and refresh its browser receipt with the current page owner. Preserve the operator's rewrite. This typo is not a runtime blocker and does not justify another baseline preparation cycle.
